versionImpact.rationale: This pre-stable line includes active KFD-1 through KFD-5 and KFD-7, draft KFD-6, the formal reference layer, live Primitive cases, and a machine-readable KFD Candidate registry. KFD-1 defines the bounded Foundation Revision window and the first-stable Foundation Freeze while preserving every published coordinate. The cross-domain action candidate is activated as KFD-7 from two independently reviewed product Profiles; its Atlas, Pursuit, and Warrant elaborations retain non-binding hints for KFD-8 through KFD-10. Major remains the honest cumulative pre-stable decision and machine-surface impact while the fixed outer package line remains v1.0.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: KFD additively publishes an independently extractable Rust verifier core, native CLI, raw WebAssembly projection, and npm bin for KFD records, Buildchain release passports, Xinfa Context Packs, Xinfa Atlases, and qualified Git Workspace Episode shadows. The verifier uses only packaged public schemas and specifications, performs no network access, and remains explicitly non-qualifying and non-self-certified.

KFD additively publishes version 1 verification-bundle and verification-report schemas, registers both interfaces in standards.json, and welds the executable, schema, and responsibility-boundary surfaces under KFD-1.

The packaged verifier additively synchronizes Kungfu's structured Go route-resolution vocabulary and current Atlas golden roots from the format owner's f24721f9073bc24000343c838bb755c13c06bce0 source commit. Existing project documents remain valid because the resolution field is optional.

The pre-stable line includes substantive refinement of KFD-1 through KFD-7. KFD-1 distinguishes admitted state cuts from bounded causal records while preserving both as non-drifting load-bearing surfaces. KFD-4 replaces absolute-context assumptions with declared reference frames, inspectable transformations, and preserved invariants. KFD-7 activates the action model from commit-addressed Buildchain and Kungfu Profile evidence while preserving product-owned qualification and non-claims. Before the first stable release, fully evidenced correction may change the latest numbered structure only with breaking impact, preserved coordinates, lineage, migration, and review.
registry.json keeps schemaVersion 1 and the existing entry shape, including number, id, slug, title, kind, status, path, and url; slug and path values are stable number coordinates.

KFD keeps a version 1 candidate registry and additively gives the Atlas, Pursuit, and Warrant candidates explicit non-normative formal-reference metadata. Candidate IDs, promotion meaning, and slot binding remain unchanged; the formal pages do not allocate KFD-8 through KFD-10.

Before stable publication, KFD activates the cross-domain action principle with a falsifiable action geometry: Fact cuts are object-like admitted states, Episodes are path-like causal transitions, and Atlas, Pursuit, and Warrant independently constrain perspective, direction, and authority. Two non-isomorphic product Profiles retain counterfactual independence, session round-trip, complexity-breakpoint, context-insufficiency, retry, compensation, and causal evidence. The source-candidate lineage remains stable, KFD-8 through KFD-10 remain unallocated, literal physical spacetime or Euclidean dimensionality is not claimed, and implementation design remains product-owned.

KFD activates the cross-domain action principle while preserving action-contract Profile version 2. Direction, perspective, authority, and occurrence remain independently addressable; the contract binds the conditional session round-trip theorem, the context-insufficiency corollary, concrete Profile refinement, complexity-breakpoint evidence, and same-payload counterexamples. Schema conformance remains non-qualifying; the separate activation record binds retained product evidence and independent review.

The version 2 standards metadata registers active KFD-7, binds its decision and formal digests, publishes its action-responsibility concept vocabulary, exposes the version 2 Profile declaration, and registers the activation record and guide as cross-time surfaces. The contract fixes responsibility, transition, theorem-reference, qualification-evidence, non-claim, and activation declaration while leaving product storage and lifecycle vocabulary product-owned.

The package additively publishes formal child pages for the Atlas, Pursuit, and Warrant candidates plus the KFD-7 activation guide and machine evidence record while preserving the KFD-7 decision, promoted source-candidate lineage, and all existing package paths.

KFD now uses Buildchain v2 floating workflow refs with a consumer-owned buildchain.contract-lock.json, so Buildchain runtime contract drift is checked before heavy build or promotion work while retaining floating-ref upgrade flow.

The schemaVersion 2 site bundle additively exposes explicit non-normative formal child pages at /drafts/{id}/formal/ for candidates that declare a formalReference. Existing candidate, decision, formal, historical-case, and live-case routes remain unchanged, and renderers still do not infer routes from package layout.
KFD usage pages add consistent links to their authoritative decision, formal reference, and documentation map while stable /N/usage routes and implementation guidance remain unchanged.

KFD refreshes its collaboration interface and pre-build/artifact witnesses to expose KFD-7 decision, formal, usage, activation evidence, trust, and promoted-lineage surfaces equally to humans, agents, package consumers, and site consumers.
KFD-3 collaboration interfaces now declare explicit valueEvidence that binds participant-facing value claims to fact artifacts, evidence artifacts, KFD-2 trust assessments, and residual-risk state.
KFD now ships an explicit machine-bound public KFD-2 release trust claim and passes it into Buildchain release passport generation.

KFD-2 generic trust claims assess KFD-7 as an active action-responsibility principle. Package identity, formal binding, promotion lineage, two exact product cuts, independent review, activation verdict, and participant-facing closure are machine-checkable; universal minimality and future adopter qualification remain explicit non-claims rather than inherited evidence.

Decision documents now use stable numbered paths under decisions/KFD-N.md, while usage documentation uses docs/KFD-N-usage.md to distinguish authoritative decision text from consumer implementation notes.
KFD now declares its package version through an anchored/manual release manifest so package version state is an explicit release fact rather than an auto-derived Buildchain side effect.

The KFD to site-libkungfu-dev propagation graph now targets the downstream site's actual main branch and documents the exact KFD package surfaces consumed by kfd.libkungfu.dev, without changing the release propagation graph contract.
KFD-1 now defines breaking, additive, none, and unclassifiable as the generic compatibility-impact core, with release versioning as one projection rather than the only interpretation.

standards.json registers the KFD-7 decision, formal reference, usage page, activation guide, machine evidence record, and promoted source-candidate lineage as cross-time surfaces. The KFD-1 witness binds these surfaces and preserves the separate KFD-8 through KFD-10 candidate boundaries.

KFD publishes an experimental non-normative formal page for every numbered decision through KFD-7. KFD-7 formalizes Fact cuts, causal paths, action responsibilities, counterfactual independence, invalid states, and activation proof obligations while decisions/KFD-N.md remains normative.

KFD-4 additively publishes a version 1 contract for perspective-preserving and contrastive replay, including source-view boundaries, reconstruction loss, degraded state, and primitive-signal mismatches.

The pre-stable KFD-5 live-case registry advances from version 1 to version 2. Stable case identity and genesis remain preserved, case lifecycle is separated into active/closed/archived, and every case exposes an ontology-split surface plus one or more independently named candidate tracks with their own qualification status, claim boundary, and SHA-256-addressed KFD-5 version 3 current cut. Version 2 also permits additive qualification arguments without treating them as candidate promotion. The first case therefore tracks Pursuit and Warrant and their conditional distinguishability obligations without rewriting the fused Proof-Carrying Work Object genesis. Registry closure does not qualify or promote either candidate.

KFD-1 now publishes a machine-readable schema for canonical reader URLs, latest aliases, immutable version artifact URLs, artifact digests, source coordinates, lineage, site consumption, and archive policies that prevent same-version digest drift or destructive deletion of immutable publication prefixes.

summary: KFD v1.0 preserves seven numbered decisions and its live Primitive case system. KFD-7 is active with separate direction, perspective, authority, and occurrence responsibilities over Fact cuts and causal records. Two independently reviewed product Profiles demonstrate a session-compatible simple-work projection and fail-visible complexity expansion at exact Buildchain and Kungfu availability cuts. KFD-7 identity, formal reference, usage boundary, activation record, promotion lineage, site projection, KFD-1 surfaces, KFD-2 trust assessment, and KFD-3 participant interface are machine-auditable; universal minimality and future Profile qualification remain unclaimed, and KFD-8 through KFD-10 remain unallocated.
